name: bench-cradle-empty-b
refs: Our signed bench stage (project-owned): match its housing materials (sage enamel, sand trim, dark rubber corners, screws), its matte painterly rendering and its light from the top exactly.

The exact outline of the recess (project-owned guide), seen straight from above: the dark shape is the device lying on its back, its rounded base to the left, its antenna and carry loop to the right. The light grey is the tray around it.
prompt: Paint the empty cradle tray seen STRAIGHT FROM ABOVE (top-down, no perspective, the tray's edges parallel to the frame), filling the whole frame edge to edge: a sage enamel tray with a sand trim around the border, and in its middle a padded recess cut exactly to the dark outline of the second reference, at that size and place, with a narrow channel for the antenna and a small round notch for the carry loop on the right. The recess is lined with dark matte rubber padding and is EMPTY: no device, no screen, no eggs, no plates. Matte painterly rendering exactly as the first reference, light from the top, a soft flat shadow along the recess's upper inner edge. Plain and functional. No text, no glow, no lamps, no hoses, no people, no hands, no background outside the tray.
